title: Small wins stacked every day

scenes.say: You do not need a big break.
scenes.visual: a tall brick wall seen from below against a grey sky

scenes.say: You need small wins, stacked every day.
scenes.visual: hands stacking one brick on top of a neat row of bricks, close up

scenes.say: Make the bed. Make the call. Do the rep.
scenes.visual: a neatly made bed in a simple room, morning light through a window
a single footprint in wet sand at the edge of the sea

scenes.say: One year of it looks like a different person.
scenes.visual: a long trail of footprints across a beach leading into the distance
a man placing a heavy plate on a barbell in a garage gym

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: sunlight breaking through clouds over a city, wide shot

caption: Small wins, stacked every day. That is the whole plan.
